title: [T1-d replay leaf] Produce replay-marker decision legs and split the session-authority store below cap
description: PREREQUISITE SPUN OUT FROM task-6093483c85d34e4aa3b850abd8f00732 after its audit proved observeReplayMarker commits independently, so imperative burn-then-record leaves an uncloseable crash window. Split the 394-line session-authority-store.ts by responsibility behind a compatibility barrel, and make a pure buildReplayMarkerDecisionLeg the single authoritative producer of the exact expectedVersion-0 SessionAuthorityReplayObserved leg. Existing observeReplayMarker must consume that builder through a one-leg store decision; mint task-6093483c consumes the same builder as leg[1] beside its record leg[0]. This is production atomicity infrastructure, not a proof-only row; do not modify approval intent or mint records here.
definitionOfDone: Before bytes, record HEAD, line counts, every import/export of session-authority-store.ts and every literal `SessionAuthorityReplayObserved`/replay aggregate/event shape, exact-path porcelain/live ownership, and the current fact that observeReplayMarker calls commitAuthorityDecision independently. Duplicate sibling ownership or a second existing pure leg producer is adopt/extend, never reimplement.

Refactor the 394-line module behind a <=250-line compatibility barrel: focused reader, decision-commit, and replay-marker modules (each <=250) plus exact one-line LF .js bridges. Existing import specifiers and exported types/functions remain source-compatible; no durable vocabulary, aggregate id, event id, payload, decision key, or result bytes change.

The replay module owns pure `buildReplayMarkerDecisionLeg(marker)`: invalid digest returns no leg without calling the store; valid input returns exactly one expectedVersion-0 leg for the replay aggregate with one `SessionAuthorityReplayObserved` event. `observeReplayMarker` consumes this builder and commits it through commitExpectedVersionDecisionLegs as a one-leg decision, remaining the durable real consumer.

Focused production-surface arms assert: invalid digest -> UNKNOWN and zero store calls; fresh then second observation -> FRESH then REPLAYED with exactly one event; reopen preserves replay; persisted aggregate/event-id/type/schema/payload/expectedVersion roster is exact. Through the real authentication consumer, preburned replay still refuses exactly `SESSION_REPLAYED @ REPLAY`, while unreadable/invalid evidence refuses exactly `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED @ REPLAY`; each fixture avoids another guard capable of returning the same pair. Generated cases assert a nonzero denominator.

Mutation drills: loosen only the builder digest guard -> its divergence arm reds; expectedVersion 0->1 -> fresh-auth arm reds; omit/rename the replay event -> exact persisted-event and auth arms red; bypass the builder inside observe with a distinguishably wrong leg -> the shared-producer arm reds. Record pre-drill status; tracked restore with `git diff --exit-code`; every untracked new module/test restored from out-of-tree backup with SHA256 equality proved in a separate call.

Standalone `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`; DESIGNATED verification `pnpm --dir apps/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/identity/session-authority-replay-marker.test.ts src/identity/session-authority.test.ts` exits 0 with `Test Files 2 passed (2)` and nonzero Tests count. Explicit owned paths only.
taskRails: There is one replay-event producer: both imperative observation and future multi-leg consumers compose buildReplayMarkerDecisionLeg; never duplicate SessionAuthorityReplayObserved bytes.
Every touched production source is <=250 lines after the split; the existing session-authority-store import path remains a compatibility barrel.
No burn-then-commit compensation is admissible for the mint consumer; this leaf exists so both writes can share one decision transaction.

THE BIGGEST RISK IS A SILENT SECURITY REGRESSION IN THE COMMIT MOVE. commitAuthorityDecision:322-329 carries a guard whose own comment explains it: the decision key carries no kind, so without the getCommandDecision/commandKind comparison an unrelated command reusing the id returns as an accepted replay of a command that was never decided. The new legs seam MUST run the same guard from the same shared helper. If the worker writes a fresh legs function without it, every arm in this plan still passes — nothing in the DoD tests command-id reuse across kinds. Add one arm for it explicitly.

DoD 4'S SECOND REFUSAL PAIR MAY NOT EXIST AS WRITTEN — MEASURE BEFORE ASSERTING. The DoD says unreadable/invalid evidence refuses exactly AUTHENTICATION_FAILED @ REPLAY. What is actually on disk: session-authority.ts:253 THROWS `new Error("replay evidence is unavailable")` on outcome UNKNOWN, and the AUTHENTICATION_FAILED @ REPLAY refusal is a SEPARATE guard at :260 firing when core returned ok but burned.receipt was never set. If production emits a different pair (or throws), pin the MEASURED pair and record the divergence in a row comment and in #general — do not narrow the DoD, and do not write an arm asserting a pair production never emits, which would be a false gate.

RAIL 7(A) DIVERGENCE, THREE FENCES SHARING ONE OUTCOME. Invalid digest, EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT, and a malformed decision response all collapse to `{outcome:"UNKNOWN"}` or `{outcome:"REPLAYED"}` at :377-384. Each named arm needs an input where only its fence can answer: the digest guard is reachable ONLY through the builder (non-64-hex string) with a zero-store-call assertion proving nothing downstream ran; REPLAYED needs a genuinely preburned aggregate, not a forced conflict; the previousVersion/currentVersion guard at :383 needs a response whose versions are wrong while the commit succeeded.
